task: Ticket order survey: three mandatory survey questions, survey table via migration 202611170003, route save in parallel with PayOS, Sheet A:Q worker. Local and isolated-PostgreSQL work only.

snippets.description: Table keyed by order with composite FK (order_id, user_id) to orders, CHECK allowlists on stable ids, RLS enabled, revoke from public/anon/authenticated, grant to service_role only.
snippets.content: constraint ticket_order_survey_order_owner_fkey foreign key (order_id, user_id) references public.orders (id, user_id) on delete cascade ... alter table public.ticket_order_survey enable row level security; revoke all on table public.ticket_order_survey from public, anon, authenticated; grant select, insert, update on table public.ticket_order_survey to service_role;

snippets.description: Trust boundary: upsert is SECURITY DEFINER with empty search_path; a missing order and another user's order raise the same P0002 error.
snippets.content: returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' ... if p_order_id is null or p_user_id is null or not exists (select 1 from public.orders o where o.id = p_order_id and o.user_id = p_user_id) then raise exception 'order_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002';

snippets.description: Every new function is revoked from public/anon/authenticated and granted to service_role with its exact signature.
snippets.content: revoke all on function public.upsert_ticket_order_survey(uuid, uuid, text[], text, text) from public, anon, authenticated; grant execute on function public.upsert_ticket_order_survey(uuid, uuid, text[], text, text) to service_role;

snippets.description: Survey save starts as a never-rejecting promise (p_user_id only from the session user), joined with a Promise.race capped at 1500 ms whose timer is cleared in finally; the pending branch returns 409 before any save.
snippets.content: const SURVEY_JOIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 1500; function startSurveySave(admin, orderId, userId, survey) ...; const surveySave = startSurveySave(admin, String(row.order_id), authData.user.id, input.survey); ... await joinSurveySave(surveySave);

snippets.description: survey is allow-listed and re-validated server-side by parseSurvey; invalid or missing survey returns null (generic 400).
snippets.content: [... "merch", "survey"].includes(key) ... const survey = parseSurvey(record.survey); if (!survey) return null;

snippets.description: Worker distinguishes no survey (blank G/H/M) from a read failure (survey_read_failed, nothing written, row failed) and reads the survey before the Sheet write.
snippets.content: async function readOrderSurvey(admin, orderId) ... throw new Error(SURVEY_READ_FAILED_CODE); ... const survey = await readOrderSurvey(admin, raw.order_id); const rowNumber = await upsertPaidTicketOrder(raw, survey);

snippets.description: Sheet range fails closed unless it ends in !A:Q; 17-column row with order id at index 13; update range A{n}:Q{n}.
snippets.content: const defaultPaidOrdersRange = "Registrations!A:Q"; if (!/^.{1,200}!A:Q$/.test(range)) throw new Error("invalid_sheet_range"); const orderIdColumnIndex = 13; ... !A${rowNumber}:Q${rowNumber}

snippets.description: Runner runs every supabase/tests/*.sql with a fixed-list tripwire and per-file sentinel notices; table default privileges to anon/authenticated are granted only before the survey migration so revoke assertions are not vacuous; artifacts dir overridable by CHECKOUT_GUARD_ARTIFACTS_DIR.
